page_title: LEV 2-0 UNI | Bayer Leverkusen v Union Berlin 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+2' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
90+1' A lofted pass into the box is met by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin), who rifles a shot just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) is coming onto the pitch as Ernest Poku cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.

85' Frederik Ronnow makes a brilliant save! Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the top of the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
85' Bayer Leverkusen hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
82' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
81' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Christian Michel Kofane.
80' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Edmond Tapsoba with a fine lofted pass.
78' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
71' Here comes a substitution. Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Christopher Trimmel.
71' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Diogo Leite and he is replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
69' Substitution. Ezequiel Fernandez walks off the pitch and Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
68' The attendance is 30210.
68' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
66' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
64' A substitution has been made. Woo-Yeong Jeong goes off and Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) comes on.
64' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Andras Schafer will be replaced by Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin).
64' Substitution. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) on for Oliver Burke.
62' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

57' OFF THE POST! Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
54' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
53' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
52' The ball goes out for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen can continue in their attacking effort.

52' The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick. Wasted effort! Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
49' 2 - 0 Goal! Frederik Ronnow makes a huge mistake and Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.

48' A precise short pass from Arthur releases Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) comes off for Arthur.
46' Kasper Hjulmand has made a change at the break. Ibrahim Maza has come on in place of Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' Referee Christian Dingert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+9' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+8' The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
45+7' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+6' What was Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

45+5' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' The game is interrupted. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) suffers a horrific injury!
44' The ball is out of play and Union Berlin manage to earn a corner.
43' Frederik Ronnow displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
41' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
38' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) failed to convert a long-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
38' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) makes a strong challenge and Christian Dingert blows for a foul. Free kick. Bayer Leverkusen will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
37' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) sends an accurate short pass. Loic Bade controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
35' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Lucas Vazquez laid the ball off to Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
32' A pass by Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
31' A spell of possession for Bayer Leverkusen in an attempt to control the game.
31' The Union Berlin players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
29' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) has a great chance to score, but he blasts the ball well wide of the left post.

26' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
25' The ball possession at the moment is 79:21.
21' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
19' Some patient build-up play from Bayer Leverkusen as they look to unlock the defence.

19' What a great effort! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
16' Union Berlin force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' A cross from a corner kick by Bayer Leverkusen is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

13' The free kick into the box finds Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen), who heads the ball towards the top left corner, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

10' A pass travels right across the box to Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken denies him with a decent save.
8' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

6' The game is pretty dull as Bayer Leverkusen are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
5' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
3' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
